gen-dafont-college-gf-kufam: Kufam runs a single track width, like neon tubing, with generous curves and a body that crowds the line while its ascenders barely show. And College brings the muscle, big counters and bold curves that match its stems, which is the sharpest thing about this pairing.
gen-dafont-college-gf-lexend: Oversized lowercase and open jaws on every curve make the text feel approachable and easy to follow. Lexend keeps that thickness steady around bends, while College hits harder with big counters and curves as heavy as its stems, the real spark of this pair.
gen-dafont-college-gf-lexend-deca: Approachable is the first word that comes to mind for the body, though College up top is all dynamic punch. Lexend Deca keeps a plain, unshaded line that never swells, with terminals that stop short of curling, so a long read stays smooth.
gen-dafont-college-gf-liter: Liter reads modern and tall, with no stroke contrast at all. College is built to command with big counters and bold curves, while Liter's wide-mouthed round forms are built to carry lines of text.
gen-dafont-college-gf-mada: Heavy curves, each as thick as a straight stem, give College its dynamic bite. But Mada's towering midzone and curves that refuse to close are what do the quiet work of carrying text, where the heading simply grabs attention.
gen-dafont-college-gf-martel-sans: Martel Sans reads open and modern, with a high mean line running across every word. And its generous curves keep a long passage moving smoothly, a steady counterweight to College's bold, dynamic drawing above.
gen-dafont-college-gf-matangi: College draws every curve as heavy as a straight stem, with big counters. Matangi answers with twine-like strokes and a hefty lowercase, and that clash of two chunky builds is what makes this pairing memorable.
gen-dafont-college-gf-maven-pro: Maven Pro brings a welcoming gap in the c and a gentle, high-waisted lowercase. Maven Pro and College make a strong match, because the heading hits with big counters and the body quietly keeps its line thickness steady.
gen-dafont-college-gf-michroma: Michroma gives each letter a wide berth, with tall bodies and stubby ascender tips. Yet a longer passage still feels open and steady, with curves that leave daylight beside College's rounded-wire, dynamic heading.
gen-dafont-college-gf-miriam-libre: College leads with dynamic authority, its curves as thick as its stems and its counters big. Miriam Libre follows with the weight of drawn wire and a sturdy lowercase, so a longer passage feels approachable and open.
